name: Kanguru
scene: A kangaroo mid-hop against broad flowing blue sky bands.
notes: Medium design sheet; requested target 28–45 panes. Generated with vitray_fox.png as style reference, then regenerated once after review to improve closure, shading and forearm spacing. Reviewed revised image: natural kangaroo silhouette and exclusive warm subject / blue background pairs preserved; snout boundary improved. Remaining doubts: subtle shading persists, forearms contain unoutlined warm colour transitions, some adjacent subject panes repeat colours, small tail/hip triangles and narrow junctions need attention during tracing. Raster connected-component estimate is approximately 49 panes above 500 pixels, exceeding target; tiny additional fragments are possible. This is the reviewed design-stage output, not audited game geometry or finished glass artwork.
